a:r.a:t: Looping of DNA allows distant enhancers to modulate assembly at promoters.

p:cNvPr.descr: A three-part diagram illustrating eukaryotic promoters and regulatory proteins. In part a, labeled activation, there are two blue lines labeled DNA on the right. The lines start right and extend left, curve down and left, and then curve right. Near the top right, the lines are shaded deeply and labeled, UAS. To the left of that there are four crescent-shaped HMG proteins lodged on the lines. Further down on the lines, two purple structures with two tan and purple bases each, labeled transcription activators and coactivators, are lodged on the line. To the right of that, there is a splice in the lines, and to the right of that is a large yellow structure with several components. The back part is labeled TBP. A green arrow points down from TBP to where the blue lines end on a brown structure. Below that is a tan folded structure that has the letters, “ON” in green on top of it. Below the ON is a green structure that sits on top of a brow structure, which has a purple shaded area lodged into the beginning of the blue lines, through a white structure. To the right of this is the bottom part of the tan structure, which is labeled Pol II. A brown kidney-shaped structure with a handle on top sits on top of Pol II, and the top of the handle is a light purple boomerang structure, sitting on top of the ON. Below Pol II is a yellow section labeled TFIID. An arrow points up from the top of the brown structure with the purple shaded (where the blue lines enter) and right to the bottom of the purple boomerang. To the right of this is an oddly-shaped gray structure that has an opening at the top. The blue lines near the green structure become brown and extend right, ending to the right of the gray structure. Toward the end of these brown lines is a splice, labeled Gene. The entire complex of structures in the right corner of the blue lines is labeled Pol II initiation complex. A long, curved green arrow points down from UAS to the top of TBP, and another curved green arrow also points away from the transcription activators and coactivators to TBP. To the right of UAS are two green wavy lines, labeled IncRNA; the top one has a short green arrow with dashed lines pointing to UAS, and a short curved arrow points away from UAS to a cloud-like purple structure in the center, labeled Mediator. A green arrow points from the transcription activators and coactivators to the bottom left of the mediator.

p:cNvPr.descr: A three-part diagram illustrating eukaryotic promoters and regulatory proteins. In part b is a similar structure as in part a, but this time the lncRNA have moved down between the transcription activators and coactivators and the TBP structures. Above them are two red oblong structures, labeled Repressors and/or IncRNAs. A short red arrow points left from lncRNA to transcription activators and coactivators, and another short red arrow points away from the repressors to the mediator. A long arrow points up from the repressors to UAS, and a curved red arrow points from the bottom of the repressors to the brown structure on top of the purple-shaded area where the blue lines enter the complex on the right. Finally, a red arrow also points from the repressors to the TBP. Where the ON used to be, there is now a red OFF in bold letters.
